children.name: FAQ Headline
children.characters: Questions before you enter the investor process?

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: We align your company's profile, stage, and sector with the specific investment theses of our verified network to ensure high-quality, relevant introductions.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: No. We provide the structural readiness, data room integrity, and network access, but the final investment decision rests solely on market forces and investor conviction.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Standardized, platform-integrated Non-Disclosure Agreements are executed digitally before granular Data Room access is granted to any prospective investor.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What goes in the Data Room?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Historical financials, cap table, corporate governance docs, material contracts, IP assignments, and detailed strategic plans, all organized per institutional standards.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Founders must be prepared to dedicate significant time to investor Q&A, management presentations, and rapid response to diligence inquiries over a 3–6 month period.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Initial screening, business model review, technical diligence, financial audit, legal compliance check, and final investment committee approval.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Lead investors construct and issue the initial Term Sheet detailing valuation, rights, and board structure. Followers generally syndicate on these terms.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: A signed term sheet is generally non-binding (except for exclusivity/confidentiality). Closing depends on satisfactory completion of final confirmatory diligence.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Yes, running a parallel process is standard until a term sheet with a "no-shop" (exclusivity) clause is signed with a lead investor.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Funds are wired, equity is issued, the cap table is updated, board seats are finalized, and you transition from fundraising mode back into aggressive execution mode.
